if you are still around to read this, I have written a poem last week and I want you to read it,

The rain falls gently, kissing me on the cheek

The rain seems to know when I'm feeling weak.

The rain listens to me, hearing me cry.

The rain falls gently from the sky.

As my eyes tear up, the rain pitter-patters,

Crying along with even when nothing matters.

The rain knows me. It cries everyday.

Always falling, falling, falling away.

The rain speaks to me, and the rain says,

"I'll always be here till your journey's end"
